protocol: v2 Zoology-faithful (commit 3fca65c): fixed dataset, per-epoch cosine, no warmup, learned APE, dropout 0.1, power_a 0.01, early stop val_acc > 0.99

evidence.anchor_2048_64_lr2.15e-3: val_acc 0.013 @ epoch 40, LR decayed -> cell dead at this budget; run aborted, logs/calibrate_v2 log is the record
evidence.anchor_512_32_20k_examples: flat at chance through epoch 16 -> 20k-lever rejected: breakout is governed by optimization steps (~15k at 100k-run), per-epoch cosine at 20k decays LR 5x faster per step; equal-step cost equals 100k. Aborted.

decisions: L2048/L4096 cells excluded from the gate grid (anchor dead); they remain frozen grid members and move to post-GO exploratory work.
dim 256 deferred to post-GO (cost); gate judged on dim 128 rows only.
max_epochs 64 -> 48 for the grid: latest observed anchor breakout is epoch 29; T_max change applies identically to every arm, so dose comparisons stay internally consistent.
jitter cell moved from 2048/128 (dead length) to 512/64.
anchor_convergence_pending: N64 and N128 anchors not yet demonstrated; the grid itself provides them (anchor dose is part of the grid). If the anchor fails on N64 AND N128, only N32 supports the gate -> insufficient cells; stop and re-plan per prereg section 7.

amendment_2026-08-25_gate_sign.resolution: signed reading stays PRIMARY (letter of the pre-data implementation); analyse() additionally reports the absolute reading. hardware: 2026-08-25: A6000s run 82-86C under load (poor case cooling); GPU power limit may be capped (e.g. nvidia-smi -pl 230) at any time, including mid-grid. No A-0/A-1 endpoint gates on wall-clock or throughput, so this changes nothing scientific; wall_s fields are provenance only and must not be compared across different power-limit settings. Record the actual -pl value and change time in logs/ when applied.
